definitions.gloss: to succeed, to be successful, to achieve success
definitions.explanation: To accomplish a goal, achieve a desired result, or attain success in an endeavor.

examples.japanese: {実験|じっけん}が{成功|せいこう}した。
{彼|かれ}は{努力|どりょく}の{末|すえ}に{事業|じぎょう}を{成功|せいこう}させた。
examples.english: He made the business a success after much effort.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{失敗|しっぱい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}したが、{最後|さいご}には{成功|せいこう}して{世界中|せかいじゅう}から{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: They failed many times, but in the end succeeded and drew attention from around the world.

notes:
A compound of {成|せい} (to become, to achieve) and {功|こう} (merit, achievement). One of the most fundamental words for expressing success. The noun form {成功|せいこう} is equally common. The causative form {成功|せいこう}させる (to make something succeed) is frequently used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{成功|せいこう}: great success
- {成功|せいこう}を{収|おさ}める: to achieve success
- {成功|せいこう}{体験|たいけん}: experience of success
- {成功|せいこう}の{秘訣|ひけつ}: the secret to success
- {成功|せいこう}{率|りつ}: success rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うまくいく: to go well — casual, everyday expression for things working out
- {達成|たっせい}する: to achieve, to accomplish — focuses on reaching a specific goal or target
- {失敗|しっぱい}する: to fail — the antonym
